reasoning_steps: Identified classes related to amino acids and their properties from the text.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An AminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that contains both an amino group and a carboxyl group.
classes.comment: Amino acids are the building blocks of proteins.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An EssentialAminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that must be obtained through diet as it cannot be synthesized by the body.
classes.comment: These amino acids are crucial for protein synthesis and overall health.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A NonEssentialAminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that can be synthesized by the body.
classes.comment: These amino acids are produced within the body.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A SemiEssentialAminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that can be synthesized by the body but in insufficient amounts.
classes.comment: These amino acids require dietary supplementation.

classes.aristotelian_definition: An AlphaAminoAcid is a MaterialEntity that has both an amino and carboxyl group attached to the alpha carbon.
classes.comment: The most common type of amino acid.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A DecarboxylationReaction is a Process that converts an amino acid into an amine and carbon dioxide.
classes.comment: Involves the removal of a carboxyl group.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A Zwitterion is a MaterialEntity that contains both positive and negative ionic groups.
classes.comment: Characterized by the presence of an amino group and a carboxyl group.

classes.aristotelian_definition: A NinhydrinReaction is a Process that identifies amino acids through color change.
classes.comment: Involves the reaction of ninhydrin with amino groups.
